variables.label: Total population
variables.description: Total population (B01003).

variables.label: Households
variables.description: Occupied housing units, i.e. households (B11001).

variables.label: Median age
variables.description: Median age of the population in years (B01002).

variables.label: Under 18
variables.description: People under 18 as a share of the total population (B01001, male and female age bands summed).

variables.label: Age 65 and over
variables.description: People 65 and over as a share of the total population (B01001).

variables.label: White (non-Hispanic)
variables.description: White alone, not Hispanic or Latino, as a share of the total population (B03002).

variables.label: Black (non-Hispanic)
variables.description: Black or African American alone, not Hispanic or Latino, as a share of the total population (B03002).

variables.label: Asian (non-Hispanic)
variables.description: Asian alone, not Hispanic or Latino, as a share of the total population (B03002).

variables.label: Hispanic or Latino
variables.description: Hispanic or Latino of any race as a share of the total population (B03002).

variables.label: Median household income
variables.description: Median household income in the past 12 months, inflation-adjusted dollars of the final ACS year (B19013). Topcoded medians are kept as published.

variables.label: Per-capita income
variables.description: Per-capita income in the past 12 months (B19301).

variables.label: Below the poverty line
variables.description: People with income below the poverty line (ratio of income to poverty level under 1.00) as a share of the population for whom poverty status is determined (C17002; B17001 is not published for block groups).

variables.label: Unemployment rate
variables.description: Unemployed people as a share of the civilian labor force, ages 16 and over (B23025).

variables.label: In the labor force (16+)
variables.description: People in the labor force (civilian plus armed forces) as a share of the population 16 and over (B23025).

variables.label: Bachelor's or higher (25+)
variables.description: Bachelor's, master's, professional or doctoral degree as a share of the population 25 and over (B15003).

variables.label: Housing units
variables.description: Total housing units, occupied plus vacant (B25001).

variables.label: Vacant units
variables.description: Vacant units as a share of all housing units (B25002).

variables.label: Median year built
variables.description: Median year the housing structures were built (B25035). Structures built before 1940 are reported as 1939.

variables.label: Single-family detached
variables.description: One-unit detached houses as a share of all housing units (B25024).

variables.label: 2-4 unit buildings
variables.description: Units in buildings with 2 to 4 units as a share of all housing units (B25024).

variables.label: 5-19 unit buildings
variables.description: Units in buildings with 5 to 19 units as a share of all housing units (B25024).

variables.label: 20+ unit buildings
variables.description: Units in buildings with 20 or more units as a share of all housing units (B25024).

variables.label: Renter households
variables.description: Renter-occupied units as a share of occupied housing units (B25003).

variables.label: Renter households (count)
variables.description: Renter-occupied housing units (B25003).

variables.label: Owner households (count)
variables.description: Owner-occupied housing units (B25003).

variables.label: People in rented homes
variables.description: People living in renter-occupied units as a share of the population in occupied housing units (B25008).

variables.label: Median gross rent
variables.description: Median gross rent (rent plus utilities) of renter-occupied units paying cash rent, in dollars (B25064).

variables.label: Median home value
variables.description: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, in dollars (B25077). Topcoded values are kept as published.

variables.label: Renters paying 30%+
variables.description: Renter households paying 30% or more of household income on gross rent, as a share of renter households (B25070). The denominator is the table total, which includes households whose burden could not be computed; this matches the tract card in Analysis.

variables.label: Renters paying 50%+
variables.description: Renter households paying 50% or more of household income on gross rent, as a share of renter households (B25070). The denominator is the table total, which includes households whose burden could not be computed; this matches the tract card in Analysis.

variables.label: Owners paying 30%+
variables.description: Owner households, with or without a mortgage, paying 30% or more of household income on selected monthly owner costs, as a share of owner households (B25091). The denominator is the table total, which includes households whose burden could not be computed; this matches the tract card in Analysis.

variables.label: Drive alone to work
variables.description: Workers 16 and over who drove alone (car, truck or van) as a share of all workers (B08301).

variables.label: Public transit to work
variables.description: Workers 16 and over who took public transportation (excluding taxicab) as a share of all workers (B08301).

variables.label: Walk to work
variables.description: Workers 16 and over who walked as a share of all workers (B08301).

variables.label: Bike to work
variables.description: Workers 16 and over who bicycled as a share of all workers (B08301).

variables.label: Work from home
variables.description: Workers 16 and over who worked from home as a share of all workers (B08301).

variables.label: Households with no vehicle
variables.description: Occupied housing units with no vehicle available (owner plus renter) as a share of all occupied units (B25044; B08201 gives the same share but is not published for block groups).

variables.label: Residential land
variables.description: Allegheny County property assessments (2026): every parcel placed in the area at its representative point and classed by its assessment class and use; share of parcel lot area. Homes of every size, apartment buildings and public housing.

variables.label: Commercial land
variables.description: Allegheny County property assessments (2026): every parcel placed in the area at its representative point and classed by its assessment class and use; share of parcel lot area. Shops, offices, mixed retail with homes above, parking.

variables.label: Industrial land
variables.description: Allegheny County property assessments (2026): every parcel placed in the area at its representative point and classed by its assessment class and use; share of parcel lot area. Warehouses and manufacturing.

variables.label: Institutional & public land
variables.description: Allegheny County property assessments (2026): every parcel placed in the area at its representative point and classed by its assessment class and use; share of parcel lot area. Government, schools, churches, cemeteries and charitable land.

variables.label: Vacant land
variables.description: Allegheny County property assessments (2026): every parcel placed in the area at its representative point and classed by its assessment class and use; share of parcel lot area. Parcels assessed as vacant land (residential, commercial or industrial).

variables.label: Vacant lots
variables.description: Number of parcels the county assesses as vacant land (Allegheny County property assessments, 2026).

variables.label: Parcels
variables.description: Number of assessed parcels whose representative point lies in the area (Allegheny County property assessments, 2026).

variables.label: Zoned single-unit
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Single-unit detached and attached residential (R1D, R1A).

variables.label: Zoned 2–3 unit
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Two-unit and three-unit residential (R2, R3).

variables.label: Zoned multi-unit
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Multi-unit residential (RM, R-MU).

variables.label: Zoned mixed-use & commercial
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Neighborhood and urban commercial, office, highway commercial, riverfront mixed use, Downtown (LNC, NDO, UNC, HC, RIV, GT).

variables.label: Zoned industrial
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Urban, neighborhood and general industrial (UI, NDI, GI).

variables.label: Zoned parks & hillside
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Parks and open space, and hillside (P, H).

variables.label: Zoned planned & institutional
variables.description: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts (WPRDC), share of the area's land. The district-to-family grouping follows config/zoning_rules.json. City of Pittsburgh only. Planned, institutional and special districts (EMI, SP, PUD and others).
